# Bloody Dave's Fishing Planner — LLM Data Access

This is a public fishing-planning application. Live forecasts are fetched client-side from Open-Meteo's public JSON APIs; the website itself does not store forecast data or issue app-specific API keys.

To analyse the currently selected location, query these two public endpoints with the latitude, longitude and forecast_days values for the location:

Weather endpoint template:
https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude={LATITUDE}&longitude={LONGITUDE}&hourly=temperature_2m,wind_speed_10m,wind_direction_10m,wind_gusts_10m,precipitation_probability&daily=sunrise,sunset,uv_index_max&wind_speed_unit=kn&timezone=auto&forecast_days={DAYS}

Marine endpoint template:
https://marine-api.open-meteo.com/v1/marine?latitude={LATITUDE}&longitude={LONGITUDE}&hourly=wave_height,wave_period,swell_wave_height,swell_wave_period,swell_wave_direction,wind_wave_height,sea_level_height_msl&timezone=auto&forecast_days={DAYS}&cell_selection=sea

Built-in locations:
- Fremantle Offshore: -32.0600, 115.6500
- Johnny Big Boy: -25.50945, 113.49710

Interpretation notes:
- Treat wind speed and wind-wave height as the primary small-boat comfort inputs.
- Discount organised long-period swell relative to short-period chop. Do not classify a day as unsafe from total wave height alone.
- The app regards a golden fishing hour as SL20 Go or Excellent plus a fishing score of 4 or 5 stars.
- Fishing scores are calculated locally from solunar timing, sunrise/sunset, tide movement, wind and rain. They are planning aids, not safety advice.
